name: The Tower of Althalaxx
summary: At the Tower of Althalaxx, demonic rites threaten northern Darkshore. Balthule Shadowstrike directs an Alliance assault on Athrikus Narassin, the ancient sorcerer who commands the cult from the tower’s peak.

sections.title: Breaching the Summit
sections.body: In northern Darkshore, the ruined Tower of Althalaxx shelters demonic summoning. Balthule Shadowstrike watches the tower from nearby and sees that the threat must be faced now. Athrikus Narassin dwells at the summit, an ancient night elf warlock who directs the dark rituals beneath the shattered roof.

sections.title: A Decisive Strike
sections.body: Athrikus Narassin is protected by loyal warlocks and dark magic more dangerous than the cultists on the slopes. To reach him, you must cut through his inner circle and take his severed head as proof. Balthule warns that demonic forces may regroup, but Athrikus’s death leaves the cult without its commander and brings Darkshore precious safety.

faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin is an ancient night elf warlock who commands the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx. He directs dark summonings and demonic rites in the northern Darkshore ruins.

faq.q: Where can Athrikus Narassin be found?
faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin dwells at the summit of the Tower of Althalaxx, guarded by seasoned warlocks and summoned minions.
Balthule Shadowstrike, an Alliance scout camped near the base of the Tower of Althalaxx, asks you to slay Athrikus.

faq.q: Who is Delgren mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier is an Alliance ally nearby. He sent you to coordinate with Balthule against the demonic cabal.

faq.q: What happens after Athrikus is defeated?
faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin’s death deals a critical blow to demonic operations in the area, though Balthule warns that the dark forces may regroup.

faq.q: Why is the Tower of Althalaxx dangerous to Darkshore?
faq.answer: Cultists and warlocks in the tower practice fel sorcery and summon demons into night elven lands, threatening the wilderness and nearby settlements.

angles.text: As a night elf, confronting Athrikus Narassin recalls the arcane and demonic corruption that once devastated your people.
As a warlock, Athrikus’s potent demonic magic at the summit of Althalaxx shows the danger of unbound fel worship.
As an Alliance member, helping secure northern Darkshore protects travel between Auberdine and the lands beyond.
